strings.en: Here stands the fight for justice!
Know the might of the Jovian Alliance!!
Justice is on our side! Surrender with honor!!
You came! This will finish you!!
Come at me! The Denjin is your opponent!!
So you fear our Jovian Alliance!
There's no way justice can lose!
Time to strike back! Feel my justice!
I'm terribly sorry!!
Ngh, requesting retrieval!
N-Not like this!
I'll hold out!
The will of a Jovian soldier never dies!
My hot blood won't be snuffed out by this!
Curse you, how dare you mock me!
Don't get cocky, you lackey of evil!
As if I'd lose to this!!
It pierced the space-time distortion field!?
What!?
Where did that come from!?
Nice hit! But still!
It only hit me. Bring on all you've got!
The Superior Human Corps isn't just for show!
Justice always wiiins!
You won't hit me!
The Superior Human Corps isn't just for show!
No need to even jump!
You've got no guts!
The space-time distortion field is holding!
Ngh! Out of ammo!?
Looks like you changed course after all.
Where's the enemy!?
I'll lend you my aid!!
Didn't notice, did you!? Take this too!
I'll shield you with my own body!!
Targeting the weak? Coward! I'm your opponent!!
Gekigan Beam!!
Gekigan Puunch!!
Here goes! Gekigan Shoot!!
